title: Branch DLT extraction record, schema 1.0
description: One record per model per extraction. Every value states its origin. A null is only valid alongside a reason in field_errors. Nothing in this document is reconstructed arithmetically from another Branch value except where a property name says so explicitly (density_subpanels_kg_per_m3, weight_sheathing_kg, penetration_area_sqft).

job.description: Project code, as used by the caller

source.description: Provenance. Enough to reproduce the run and to re-derive values later without re-extracting.

branch_project_guid.description: BranchDoc.ActiveDocument.UniqueId — which SC resources folder Branch itself selected. Models can carry several; this records the one actually used.

weight_source.description: How weight_kg was obtained. An enum, not a boolean, so the source can be replaced later without a schema break. Never 'reconstructed'.

complexity_config_version.description: Version of the threshold table behind the boolean descriptors. Stamped so any score is reproducible and re-tunable without re-extraction.

extraction.description: Outcome of the walk. status is authoritative; a caller must not infer success from the presence of panels.

status.description: 'ok' requires a complete walk with no per-field errors. Zero panels is 'no_branch_content', never 'ok'.

types_recognised.description: Post-dedup distinct counts, keyed by OM type name.

types_unrecognised.description: Types seen but not modelled by this schema version. Never silently dropped — twelve types were found where six were expected.

overlap_with_top_level.description: Objects present in BOTH collections, per type, before dedup. Measured 0 on every type of every model tested, but Branch permits it, so it is measured rather than assumed.

dropped.description: Home for partial_truncated. A traversal exception must record where it happened and how many objects were lost.

excluded.description: What the layer/type policy removed. Reported, never silent.

reference_types.description: Dap1DReference / Dap2DReference / LineSupportReference instances excluded by type.

lod.description: Derived from the census against the StructureCraft LOD ladder. 'observed' is a floor, not a claim of completeness.

declared.description: Manual until Branch carries LOD as a model state.

sequencing.description: Install Sequence is a 350 marker; Numbering plus Truck/Bundle are 450 markers. Conflating them over-reports.

elements.description: RESERVED. Populated and validated, but no downstream consumer in this phase.

field_errors.description: field name -> why it is null or untrustworthy, e.g. 'GetWeight() returned NaN'. A null value with no entry here is a schema violation, not a value.

panel.description: One DLT. Source attribution per field is in each description.

mark.description: DLT.Mark — contract: TypePrefix + TypeSuffix + '-' + InstanceMark, e.g. P110-01. Downstream half_label() depends on the suffix.

weight_kg.description: DLT.GetWeight(). NaN is an error, never a zero.

net_area_sqft.description: Sum of subpanel NetArea, raw then rounded once — deliberately NOT DLT.NetArea, so the bit-identical regression invariant against schema 0.3 survives. DLT.NetArea is emitted separately as a cross-check.

net_area_sqft_native.description: DLT.NetArea. Cross-check only. If it disagrees with net_area_sqft beyond rounding, that is a finding to investigate, not a number to choose between.

species.description: BranchMaterial.Species (SpeciesTypes enum) mapped through the versioned display table. Null when Material.Name == 'Unassigned'.

material_name.description: BranchMaterial.Name. Never the literal 'Unassigned' — that becomes null plus a field_errors entry.

density_assigned_kg_per_m3.description: BranchMaterial.Density — what the panel's material says.

weight_subpanels_kg.description: Sum of DLTSubpanel.GetWeight(). The structural timber weight.

weight_sheathing_kg.description: Sum of DLTSheathing.GetWeight(), read DIRECTLY rather than derived by subtracting subpanels from the total. Reading both halves independently makes the composition verifiable: subpanels + sheathing must reconcile with GetWeight(), and a mismatch beyond 0.5 kg is reported on weight_kg. That is the only independent check on GetWeight(), which otherwise has to be taken on trust. DLT.GetWeight() is a COMPOSITE - subpanels plus sheathing, with cutouts already deducted - so reporting only the total makes it unexplainable. On a reference model 28,563 kg of a 214,608 kg total was sheathing, 13.3%, which is exactly the gap that made the native figure look 15% adrift from a volume x density calculation. It was never adrift.

sheathing_present.description: DLT.SheathingTop or SheathingBottom is set. Observed on every panel of a reference model, top only.

volume_sheathing_m3.description: Sum of DLTSheathing.Volume. Read directly, not inferred.

volume_total_m3.description: volume_m3 + volume_sheathing_m3, i.e. all the material actually present. A total VOLUME is a real physical quantity so it is reported; a total DENSITY deliberately is not, because averaging timber against plywood describes no material anyone would act on.

density_sheathing_kg_per_m3.description: weight_sheathing_kg / volume_sheathing_m3. Scope-matched like the subpanel density, and an independent check on the sheathing material.

sheathing_material_name.description: Material on the sheathing, which is assigned independently of the subpanels. A panel can have unassigned subpanels and sheathing that still carries a material - in which case GetWeight() returns sheathing weight alone.

density_subpanels_kg_per_m3.description: weight_subpanels_kg / volume_m3. The ONLY honest density here, because it is the one scope where numerator and denominator describe the same material - DLT.Volume covers the subpanels only. On a reference model this lands on exactly 450.0, the assigned SPF density, which is what validates the material read. Do NOT divide weight_kg by volume_m3: that mixes a sheathing-inclusive weight with a subpanel-only volume and yields a figure that looks like a defect but is an arithmetic error. Null is legitimate for a non-uniform build-up such as an acoustic panel, which has no single density.

thickness_mm.description: DEPRECATED: this field contains DLTParameters.LamWidth in mm, not a thickness. Retained for backwards compatibility only. New consumers must use width_mm instead.

width_mm.description: DLTParameters.LamWidth in mm, rounded to 2 decimals. The molder-critical dimension.

stack_count.description: Total lam stacks across all subpanels of the panel.

counts.description: From forward navigation on the panel, not a reverse HostId join.

planar_cuts.description: PlanarCut derives from Dap2dBase and is a penetration; counting only Dap2d undercounts cutouts.

complexity.description: Tier 2: derived once, in C#, from native atomics only. If an input atomic is null the descriptor is null — never defaulted. Contains no time, duration, or labour estimate of any kind, by user directive.

penetration_area_sqft.description: GrossArea - NetArea, computed from the RAW native values before rounding. Do NOT recompute it by subtracting the published gross_area_sqft and net_area_sqft columns: those are rounded to 2dp and 1dp respectively, so the difference can come out spuriously non-zero or even negative. On a reference model 66 of 138 panels carry a non-zero value, max 20.85 sqft. This is material actually removed, so it also drives has_penetrations.

penetration_count.description: daps_non_fastener + planar_cuts. ⚠ This is NOT a count of holes, and it can be non-zero while penetration_area_sqft is 0 — a dap is a surface recess, not a through-cutout, so it adds machining without removing net area. Observed on a reference model: 22 of 63 panels had a non-zero count with zero area. Read the two fields as machining-operation count and cutout area, never as two views of the same thing. has_penetrations is driven by the AREA, not by this count.

corner_count.description: Corners of the outer loop of the largest planar face of DLT.NetAreaGeometry - the panel's net plan view, whose area equals DLT.NetArea. NOT from DLT.Boundary: that is the nominal rectangle and reports 4 on every panel. NetAreaGeometry is a closed solid where a plain box has 6 faces and each notch adds 2, so notches appear as real outline corners. A reference model yields 4:72, 6:55, 8:11.

perimeter_m.description: DLT.Boundary.GetLength(). Correct despite Boundary being the nominal rectangle: a rectilinear notch replaces two removed edges with two of equal length, so perimeter is preserved. Verified equal to the net plan face outline length.

is_rectangular.description: corner_count == 4 with four right angles, measured on the net plan face. 72 true / 66 false on a reference model.

has_penetrations.description: penetration_area_sqft > 0.01, i.e. material actually removed. Deliberately NOT derived from penetration_count: a dap is a surface recess, so a count-based flag was true on every panel of every model and carried no information.

blank_volume_m3.description: Volume of DLT.NetAreaGeometry, the panel's blank as a closed solid before cuts are applied. A plain blank has exactly 6 faces.

machined_volume_m3.description: blank_volume_m3 - volume(DLT.FinalGeometry): material machined out of the blank. This is what penetration_area_sqft cannot see - that field is gross minus net PLAN area, so a panel machined all over its faces still reports 0.00, which on one reference job was every one of 105 panels while a fifth of the blank had in fact been cut away. Needs two volume reads and NO boolean operation. Verified on 105 panels: never negative, and FinalGeometry's volume equals DLT.Volume on 104 of them. Null with a reason rather than 0 if either solid is unreadable, and null if FinalGeometry encloses MORE than the blank, which would mean the two are not the blank/cut pair assumed here.

machined_pct.description: machined_volume_m3 / blank_volume_m3 x 100, from the unrounded values. The most legible complexity figure: 20.3% of the blank on one reference job against 1.1% on another, where the first is plain rectangles that are heavily machined and the second has complex outlines but light machining. Do not recompute from the two published columns - they are rounded, and on a very small panel that introduces visible error.

daps_through.description: Non-sheathing daps on this panel whose Depth reaches or exceeds DLT.DepthOfSubpanel, i.e. cutters that sever the laminate. Equality counts as through. Null with a reason if DepthOfSubpanel is unavailable.

daps_surface.description: Non-sheathing daps shallower than DLT.DepthOfSubpanel: recesses that remove no net area, which is exactly why penetration_area_sqft reports 0 on a heavily machined panel.

daps_sheathing.description: Daps with IsSheathingDap set - they cut the sheathing layer, not the laminate, and are counted separately because they are a different operation.

operation_classes.description: Sorted distinct geometric operation classes on the panel. Reflects the variety of cutting operations required during CNC fabrication.

cut_variants.description: Distinct (Depth, Width, CornerRadius) combinations among non-sheathing daps: how many tool configurations the panel needs, where ten identical daps count once and ten different ones count ten. Deliberately a count of configurations rather than of magnitudes, because every dap MAGNITUDE is a cutting tool's magnitude and not the cut's - on one reference job 554 of 671 daps were longer than the longest panel in the model, and summing Dap2d.NetArea 'removed' 1.39x the panel area in existence.

max_dap_depth_mm.description: Deepest dap on this panel, in mm. A value above the laminate thickness simply means a cutter passes through; it is not an error.

width_mm.description: DLTSubpanel.Width in mm, 1 decimal. The CNC has a hard 1300 mm width limit that applies to the subpanel and not the panel — panels are routinely wider and are split precisely to fit — so without a real per-subpanel width the single hardest manufacturing constraint cannot be checked. On one measured 249-panel job, 477 subpanels ran up to 1298 mm against that 1300 mm limit, i.e. 2 mm of clearance.

lam_stacks.description: Lam count per lam stack, in stack index order.

stack_widths_mm.description: Width in mm per lam stack, same order as lam_stacks.

element.description: Any non-DLT Branch object, flat with a parent reference. Twelve types observed: DLT, Dap1d, Dap2d, Fastener1d, LineSupport, PanelSupport, Part3d, AssemblyBase, ConnectionInstance, TimberLinearBeam, PlanarCut, StraightBillet. The list is open — unrecognised types go to extraction.types_unrecognised, never dropped.

id.description: UniqueId — present on all twelve types; the dedup key across top-level and block collections.

host_id.description: HostId — present on all twelve types.

in_block.description: Four types were observed existing ONLY inside block definitions.

weight_kg.description: Seven of twelve types implement IWeighable; null on the other five, which are subtractive or positional.

summary.description: A pure rollup of panels[] — the document stays self-consistent by construction.

panels_with_errors.description: Count of panels carrying any field_errors entry. Non-zero forbids status 'ok'.
